AbstractText.Label: BACKGROUND
AbstractText.content: Pain in oncology patients may be related to underlying disease process, as well as a side effect of chemotherapy and radiation. More than half of all patients with a diagnosis of cancer experience pain, which is often poorly controlled. As such, the treatment of pain in oncology patients demonstrates a significant need to develop new treatment options.

AbstractText.Label: OBJECTIVE
AbstractText.content: This review summarizes 35 patents on the treatment of pain among cancer patients.

AbstractText.Label: METHOD
AbstractText.content: A thorough literature review of all patents filed in 2014 was conducted using PubMed and http://ep.espacenet.com/ as sources identify new treatment options for cancer pain.

AbstractText.Label: RESULTS
AbstractText.content: Our literature search returned 35 patents filed in 2014 related to the treatment of pain in cancer patients.

AbstractText.Label: CONCLUSION
AbstractText.content: In 2014, a number of patents were filed for the treatment of pain among oncology patients. The great variety of chemical compounds presented indicates that there is a great variety in current research for cancer-related pain. The development of novel treatment options will hopefully lead to more effective therapies in the treatment of cancer-related pain.
